title: Adapter & Hairpin annealing - DAF-SELEX
body:
### 1. Hairpin Annealing

| Reagent | Volume |
|---|---:|
| Hairpin oligo, 100 µM | 5 µL |
| 10× annealing buffer | 5 µL |
| Nuclease-free water | 40 µL |

- Heat to 94°C for 2 minutes.
- Cool gradually to 25°C, approximately 1°C/minute.
- Aliquot; prepare a 1 µM working dilution for the pilot. [Do this fresh before the reaction needs to be set up]


### 2. Adapter Annealing

| Reagent | Volume |
|---|---:|
| Adapter A, 100 µM | 5 µL |
| Adapter B, 100 µM | 5 µL |
| 10× annealing buffer | 5 µL |
| Nuclease-free water | 35 µL |

- Heat to 94°C for 2 minutes.
- Cool gradually to 25°C, approximately 1°C/minute.
- Aliquot; prepare a 1 µM working dilution for the pilot. [Do this fresh before the reaction needs to be set up]

*Both the stock solutions are 10 uM in concentrations after annealing*
